description: The Idea Table rendered EVERY row into real DOM with no cap anywhere, and CSV import was completely unbounded. A prior measurement: N=100 ~880 ms mount, N=1,000 ~6 s, and N=5,000 OOM-crashed the process even with an 8 GB heap. A consultant importing a real spreadsheet could hard-crash the tool.

status: PARTIALLY RESOLVED. A hard render cap of 500 plus an explicit CSV-import guard, chosen over virtualization with the reasoning recorded in tableRowLimits.ts: IdeaTableTool is ~5,100 lines with sticky header, column resize/reorder, inline editing, grouping and keyboard nav wired straight to real tr/td nodes, so a partial windowing that broke editing or selection would be worse than a well-built guard. Nothing is silently dropped - the banner reads 'showing first N of M' and the import either refuses or reports exactly how many rows were skipped, in pl and en (ideas.table.rowRenderCapBanner / csvImportBlockedAtCap / csvImportTruncatedAtCap, all three verified on the full dotted path). STILL OPEN: (1) post-fix behaviour at N=5,000 and N=10,000 is NOT MEASURED - the cap bounds DOM cost by construction and the N=1,000 case was measured dropping from 1,000 to 500 rendered rows, which is a structural fact rather than a timing, but the OOM ceiling was not re-tested; (2) only CSV import has its own explicit guard - the other multi-row-add paths (AI add rows, framework apply, duplicate) are protected only by the render cap, so they can still inflate the underlying data set without telling the user; (3) virtualization remains the better long-term answer and is not done.

description: The shared CanvasContextMenu loses keyboard focus on close and never implements roving tabindex. After Escape, focus lands on document.body instead of returning to the element that opened the menu (node, edge or pane), and no [role=menuitem] ever carries tabIndex>=0. Affects all seven consumers: Mind Map pane/node/edge, Whiteboard edge, Process Flow, Idea canvas, Table.
evidence: orchestrator-bisected 2026-08-11 across nine commits: src/components/MyWork/canvas/__tests__/whiteboardContextMenu.keyboard.integration.test.tsx passes 4/4 at origin/demo (9d17cac114) and fails 4/4 from 93ebc3aa20 onward - this program's FIRST commit, 'E00: forward-port Ideas navigation/context-menu unification'.
status: RESOLVED 2026-08-11. Root cause: closeAndRestore scheduled focus restore in a requestAnimationFrame, but onClose() unmounts the menu synchronously inside the same React flush, so the rAF never ran before any assertion or, for a real user, before focus had already been lost to body. Replaced with an unmount-effect cleanup mirroring useDialogA11y's canonical restore. Roving tabindex added via an activeItemId state that follows the native focus event, so every existing focus-moving call site (open-focus, Arrow keys, Home/End) updates it without bespoke wiring. Named test 4/4 green and MATCHES origin/demo's 4/4 - orchestrator ran both sides; the test file was not modified. Orchestrator's own sabotage (removing the roving tabIndex) reproduces 'expected -1 to be greater than or equal to 0'. It also fixed 2 further tests in IdeaCanvasContextMenu.cb05 that were silently broken by the same cause and equally invisible under the old scope. Dead code noted: useAccessibleMenu.ts implements roving tabindex correctly and is imported by nothing.
